findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: a_share_answer_by_id · Private data: a_share_deep_research, a_share_chain_edge · Public sink: a_share_deep_research, a_share_chain_edge, a_share_answer_by_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: a_share_answer_by_id · Private data: a_share_deep_research, a_share_chain_edge · Public sink: a_share_deep_research, a_share_chain_edge, a_share_answer_by_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
